description:
Decouple src/prompt/mod.rs from any provider-specific crate. Currently it imports provider::anthropic::Response directly; after extraction (ball bl-f8bd) that would be a cross-crate library dep, which breaks the "out-of-tree adapters don't need lernie as a dep" principle.

=== Goals ===
- New src/provider/wire.rs defines the adapter-contract non-streaming Response shape per ARCH §4.4: { id, model, stop_reason, content[], usage }.
- src/prompt/mod.rs parses adapter stdout into src/provider/wire::Response (not provider::anthropic::Response).
- lernie crate has zero library dependency on lernie-provider-anthropic. Only the invocation path (exec) connects them.
- Tests confirm the wire shape in wire.rs and the parse path in prompt handle the adapter's JSON output end-to-end.

=== Non-goals ===
- Streaming event types live in a follow-up (ball #4 adds the streaming wire to adapter; harness wire types for streaming can be added there or here depending on ordering — prefer there).
title: Harness neutral adapter-wire types
